title: Replace DateTime.now() with the DateTimeFactory clock seam in stage_sync_test.dart's track fixture
why: The `_insertTrack` helper calls the real wall clock instead of `DateTimeFactory.nowUtc()` — the established deterministic seam (routes through the swappable `LocalDayClock`) that every sibling file in this same batch uses (v16_to_v17_test.dart, v17_to_v18_test.dart, restore_skip_onboarding_test.dart, etc.). Neither field is currently asserted on so it doesn't flake today, but it's a landmine: the moment an assertion is added against stateChangedAt/activatedAt, or stage-scheduling logic branches on track age, the test becomes wall-clock-dependent and can fail non-deterministically near day/DST boundaries or under a frozen-clock CI harness.
recommendation: Swap both fields to `DateTimeFactory.nowUtc()` (or a fixed `DateTime.utc(...)` literal), matching every other file in this batch.
acceptance_criteria: grep for `DateTime.now()` in test/integration/stage_sync_test.dart returns zero hits
